method: Read public banner attributes; download PNG bytes; inspect emblem and pip pixels against retained composite colors. Keep raw dimensions, source URL, SHA-256 and geometry. RGX Ep 9 provides all four matching RGX emblem/pip colors; ORA Base matches the Lawyer palette. Variant IDs are preserved for existing settings.
rendering: The original native HUD arranges n pips on a circle at 2*pi*(i+1)/n, with an additional pi/2 for two kills. Game count cycles 1–5. This restores the correct radial artwork states; it does not reproduce Unreal shader/VFX animation.
limitations: Original Unreal shader/VFX animation is not reproduced. Ayakashi uses original composite flame fragments with the native client animation.
followUp: Ayakashi now uses the colored flame fragments in its four retained original RGBA composites. See ayakashi-flame-review.json for source rectangles, sizes and hashes. Empty downloaded independent pips are retained only as historical acquisition evidence.
